request.title: New booking request

confirmed.preheader: {sitter} is all set to care for {pets}.
confirmed.tip: You can message {sitter} any time from your booking.

declined.subject: {sitter} isn't available this time
declined.title: {sitter} can't take this booking

cancelled.title: Booking cancelled
cancelled.bodyByOwner: {owner} cancelled {pets}'s {noun}. Those dates are open again on your calendar.
cancelled.bodyBySitter: Sorry, {sitter} had to cancel {pets}'s {noun}. You can find another sitter for the same dates.
cancelled.bodyByAdmin: WagStays cancelled {pets}'s {noun}. If you have any questions, our support team is happy to help.
cancelled.points: {amount} in WagPoints is back in your wallet.

completed.ownerBody: {sitter} marked {pets}'s {noun} as complete. We hope it went wonderfully! A short review helps {sitter} and other pet parents in your neighbourhood.
completed.sitterBody: {pets}'s {noun} is complete. Thank you for taking such good care of them.
completed.sitterAsk: How was it working with {owner}? Your rating only takes a minute and helps keep WagStays great for sitters.

reminder.ownerBody: Just a reminder that {sitter} is caring for {pets} tomorrow. Need to change something? Message {sitter} from your booking.
reminder.sitterBody: Just a reminder that you're caring for {pets} tomorrow. The booking page has the meeting address and care notes.
